settings.text: How long until I see results?

settings.repere: Texte · Most people notice steadier energy aft…
settings.text: Most people notice steadier energy after meals within the first two weeks. Blood sugar and cholesterol markers move slower — give it eight to twelve weeks before a retest. Berberine builds with consistent daily use.

settings.repere: Texte · How many capsules do I take, and when?
settings.text: How many capsules do I take, and when?

settings.repere: Texte · Two capsules a day with meals — one wi…
settings.text: Two capsules a day with meals — one with lunch and one with dinner works well for most people. Taking it alongside food is when it does its best work.

settings.repere: Texte · Will it upset my stomach?
Texte · Berberine is generally well tolerated …
settings.text: Berberine is generally well tolerated at this dose. A small number of people notice loose stools or mild cramping in the first week; taking it with food usually settles it. If not, drop to one capsule and build back up.

settings.text: Ask your doctor or pharmacist first — especially if you take blood sugar or blood pressure medication, as berberine can add to their effect. Call us before you order and we will talk it through.
